pages.note: Cards show no counts (no users, stars or version), the way the Next.js and Expo showcases do, so nothing on the page goes stale; users stay in the data only to order the grid. The page carries the homepage footer. Moved 2026-09-15 from docs/used-by to /showcase (redirects from /used-by and /docs/used-by). Rebuilt 2026-09-15 as a curated list, the way the Next.js and Expo showcases are. Five public repositories that depend on Extension.js are on it, each verified by reading package.json (dependency on `extension` at 1.1.1 or later or a dist-tag, plus a script calling the CLI) and a manifest.json: better-lyrics/better-lyrics (^4.1.5; Chrome, Firefox, Edge; 100K+ users), StarCitizenToolBox/StarCitizenBoxBrowserEx (^2.0.0-rc.23; Chrome 1,000, Firefox 125, Edge 3,684), alex9849/chrome-simple-keyboard (^2.0.0-rc.23; Chrome 4,000), migteam/better-trello-browser-extension (latest; Chrome, Firefox; 1.1K), joaomagfreitas/send-to-pocket-book extension/ (latest; Chrome, Firefox; 290). Users come from the Firefox Add-ons API v5, the Edge getproductdetailsbycrxid endpoint and the Chrome Web Store page, floored to two significant digits. Store ids were checked against listing titles.
